messages:
Raj: FYI saw a flurry of GPU pod evictions in eu-west-1 this morning during a spot reclaim window. multiple node replacements + immediate scale-down caused churn.
Marta: ouch. any indication it was the cluster-autoscaler vs AWS reclaim timing? :thinking_face:
Raj: logs show ASG terminated nodes, but CA quickly marked nodes NotReady then scaled down before pods could reschedule to warm nodes. we lost a couple RB latency SLOs.
Chris: did the node preStop hook run? I remember earlier we had pods blocked on shutdown for 30s
Raj: some containers had terminationGracePeriodSeconds=5 which is too short for checkpoint flush. others had none and evicted immediately.
Emma: what if we add a short preemptive 'warmup' pool per AZ (small reserve of expensive g4s) that we keep tainted for on-demand overflow? autoscaler could use scale-up delays to prefer those.
Marta: sounds doable but expensive. we should consider using a tiny pinned pool + aggressive preempt for certain namespaces (inference-heavy). Terraform + taints can enforce it.
Ana: +1 but also suggest tweaking cluster-autoscaler flags: --scan-interval, --scale-down-unneeded-time, --balance-similar-node-groups, and set --expander=random/least-waste based on our workload.
Chris: here's a quick helm values tweak I tested locally that delays scale-down and buys time for graceful moves:
```
clusterAutoscaler:
  extraArgs:
    scale-down-unneeded-time: "15m"
    scale-down-unready-time: "10m"
    scan-interval: "30s"
```
Raj: also we should standardize terminationGracePeriodSeconds and add preStop hooks for model checkpoints. example preStop snippet in k8s:
```
lifecycle:
  preStop:
    exec:
      command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "./flush-checkpoint.sh && sleep 10"]
terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60
```
Emma: if we do 60s, CA still might remove nodes during ASG terminate if AWS sets InstanceProtection false immediately. we need to ensure lifecycle hooks on ASG or use node-protection during scale-in.
Marta: Terraform change: add aws_autoscaling_lifecycle_hook and set heartbeat/timeout. small snippet I used:
```
resource "aws_autoscaling_lifecycle_hook" "gpu_pre_terminate" {
  name                  = "gpu-pre-terminate"
  autoscaling_group_name = aws_autoscaling_group.gpu.name
  lifecycle_transition  = "autoscaling:EC2_INSTANCE_TERMINATING"
  heartbeat_timeout     = 300
  default_result        = "CONTINUE"
}
```
Ana: perfect. lifecycle hook + CA delay + pod preStop should drastically cut lost work.
Chris: one more thing: set pod disruption budgets for important pods so CA won't evict too many at once. also consider the prioritized eviction feature (pod priorities) so critical pods land first.
Raj: for rollout/ops, propose:
- small 2-3 node warm pool per AZ (tainted: gpu-warm=true:NoSchedule)
- terraform-managed ASG lifecycle hook with 5m heartbeat
- CA helm values to extend scale-down timings
- enforce terminationGracePeriodSeconds >= 60 and preStop scripts
- add PDBs for model-serving pods
- autoscaler expander tuned to prefer warm pool
Emma: agree. can we test in staging eu-west-1? I can patch our helm chart for CA and spin up a 1-node warm pool. Chris can add PDBs + preStop.
Chris: yep I'll open a PR with values and a small Terraform module for the warmpool ASG.
Marta: cost note: rough calc — keeping 3 g4s per AZ ~ incremental $X/day per region. we should gate warmpool to customer tiers (paid accounts only) and use it for production namespaces.
Raj: good call. add a feature flag and make it opt-in via Terraform var.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: staging/ca-helm-values update -> awaiting approvals (2 required)
Ana: I'll review the helm values PR. Raj, please add the lifecycle hook TF snippet to the infra repo and mark it experimental.
Raj: will do. also adding a sanity test: simulate ASG terminate in a staging cluster and confirm preStop/heartbeat extend node termination and pods successfully reschedule to warmpool.
Emma: timeline? if low risk we can land helm + CA flags this week, TF warmpool next week behind feature flag.
Chris: PRs coming in ~2h.
Marta: nice. keep an eye on metrics: pod eviction rate, P95 restart time, and cost delta. set a dashboard.
Raj: thanks team. follow-up notes will be in the infra ticket: INFRA-4321. ping me if you want test creds.
Ana: ack. :thumbsup:
